_comment: Project-specific Vibe Coding Guard settings. Values here override global config (~/.vibe-coding-guard/config.json)

analysis_mode_options.fast: Regex-only — fastest, deterministic, no LLM calls
analysis_mode_options.deep: Always use LLM reasoning — best coverage, slower
analysis_mode_options.hybrid: Regex first, LLM for ambiguous cases (recommended)
